name: Alert
description: You gain a bonus to Initiative equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you can swap Initiative with a willing ally.

name: Magic Initiate
description: You learn two cantrips and one level 1 spell from a chosen class's spell list.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn you can reroll a melee weapon's damage dice and use either total.

name: Skilled
description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20.

name: Grappler
description: You have Advantage on attacks against creatures you are grappling.

name: Archery
description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

name: Defense
description: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
description: When you roll damage for a Melee weapon attack with a Two-Handed or Versatile weapon held in two hands, treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When you make an extra attack from wielding a Light weapon, you can add your ability modifier to that attack's damage if you aren't already.

name: Boon of Combat Prowess
description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 30). When you miss with an attack roll you can hit instead, once until the start of your next turn.

name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 30). Immediately after the Attack or Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see.

name: Boon of Fate
description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 30). When a creature within 60 feet succeeds or fails a D20 Test, roll 2d4 as a bonus or penalty; once until you roll Initiative or rest.

name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
description: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (max 30). Your Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage ignores Resistance, and a natural 20 deals extra damage equal to that score.

name: Boon of Spell Recall
description: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1 (max 30). When you cast with a level 1-4 slot, roll 1d4; on the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

name: Boon of the Night Spirit
description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 30). In Dim Light or Darkness you can turn Invisible as a Bonus Action, and have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

name: Boon of Truesight
description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 30). You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.
